column1: # tRNA gene copy numbers, Saccharomyces cerevisiae
# SOURCE      GtRNAdb (Genomic tRNA Database), Chan & Lowe, UCSC
# METHOD      tRNAscan-SE predictions, as published by GtRNAdb
# HOW THIS FILE WAS MADE, STATED HONESTLY
# This table was transcribed by hand from the "tRNA Gene Summary" HTML tables
# on the page above. Hand transcription can introduce errors, so the loader
# (scripts/params.py) asserts the total equals the 275 that GtRNAdb reports
# independently in its own Overview box. That checksum catches a dropped or
# mistyped count; it does not catch two errors that cancel.
#   genes      number of tRNA genes with that anticodon in sacCer3
# The codon an anticodon decodes by Watson-Crick pairing is the reverse
# complement of the anticodon. Anticodons absent from the genome are listed
# with 0 rather than omitted, because a zero is a modelling fact (that codon
# must be read by wobble) and a missing row is only an absence of data.
# NOTE ON METHIONINE: GtRNAdb reports anticodon CAT as 5 initiator + 5
# elongator. Only the 5 elongator genes are relevant to elongation. The value
# below is the elongator count, 5, not the combined 10. This departs from the
# raw page and is recorded in params/parameters-v1.json as a stated decision.
